summary: HasType is multiplicative over products of operators; sum the bounds of `IsMarked.hasType_markOperator` over m·#Λ factors.

steps.claim: p > 0; p < x₁; HasType of the product (`HasType.prod`) over Λ repeated m times, each factor by `IsMarked.hasType_markOperator` with s = j_p.
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨_, _, h⟩ := hp.1.pos, D.hasLogUpper_of_le_of_nonneg hΛ.4.1.le, HasType.prod
    (List.replicate D.m Λ.attach.toList).flatten fun l _ ↦ hΛ.hasType_markOperator (D.jetCeil p) l.2
simp [← sum_mul, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_sum, ← Nat.cast_sum, sum_attach, -List.map_subtype] at h

steps.claim: It suffices to compare m·∑_{l∈Λ}(128A_l log b/(mp) + j_p/x^14 + x^40) with 3·loss(p).
#Λ ≤ f, ∑_l A_l ≤ a·f (`sum_card_fiberwise_eq_card_filter`), loss ≥ f(log b)²a/p, j_p ≤ 2mfa/p + 1.
